question: How many fundamental duties were added by the 42nd Constitution Amendment Act, 1976?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 10 Fundamental duties added in** Part IV(A) **of the Indian constitution by **42ⁿd Amendment Act, 1976**.
 
• Added three words to the Preamble by same Amendment, **"Socialist, Secular, and Integrity".**
 
• Fundamental duties are listed in **Article 51A **of the Constitution of India.
 
• **11th** Fundamental Duty is added by **86th Amendment Act of 2002.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **42ⁿd Amendment** increased duration of Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies from **5 to 6 years**(Later removed by 44th Amendment Act.) 
 
• Gave the Central Government more control over the **appointment of State Governors.**
 
• **Introduced** provisions for establishing **Administrative Tribunals( Article 323A and 323B)** to handle dispute related to services.
 
• It is also known as** "Mini Constitution"**
 
• Added a provision that any law passed by the Parliament related to amendment** cannot be questionable **in any court **[ Article368(4) ]**.
 
• **Introduced Part XIV** A to the Constitution, which deals with Tribunals of** Administrative disputes and Service related disputes**.
 
• **Limited Right to Property under Article 19(1)(f) **and removed it as fundamental right, **later fully removed by 44th Amendment Act**.
 
• **Indira Gandhi was the Prime Minister** of India during 42ⁿd Amendment Act.
